title: Cataneo Set to Unveil the Future of AI Engagement at IBC2026 in Amsterdam
summary: BEN’s commercial-ready AI solutions deliver human-like responses using natural language, combined with the ability to remember customer details and problem solve in real-time on mobile devices, computers and stand-alone kiosks.
body_markdown:
**About Brand Engagement Network, Inc.**
Brand Engagement Network, Inc. (NASDAQ: BNAI) is an enterprise AI software company that enables organizations to connect engagement to execution through secure, intelligent conversational AI. Powered by its proprietary Engagement Language Model (ELM™), BEN helps organizations automate workflows, improve customer experiences, and drive operational intelligence across healthcare, hospitality, mobility, government, media, retail, and other industries. For more information, visit[www.brandengagementnetwork.com](http://www.brandengagementnetwork.com/) .
